            ### Question    
            The glycosidic bond in the disaccharides is characterized by:

            ### Options

- CHAIN: "Disaccharides" -> "Contain two monosaccharide units" -> "Glycosidic bond connects the monosaccharides" -> "Involves at least one anomeric carbon" -> 80% CHAIN: "Maltose" -> "A disaccharide composed of two glucose molecules" -> "Glycosidic bond in maltose has a beta configuration" -> 70% CHAIN: "N-glycosidic bond" -> "Found in glycoproteins" -> "Not typically present in disaccharides" -> 60% CHAIN: "Disaccharides" -> "Do not typically present cargo" -> 80%

### Retrieved Validation Paths:
- (Maltose)-INTERACTS_WITH/ISA->(Sugars)-INTERACTS_WITH->(Disaccharides)
- (Disaccharides)-INTERACTS_WITH->(Enzymes)-INTERACTS_WITH->(Maltose)

            ### Task:
